transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling deeply depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for about a year now. It feels like this heavy darkness just won't go away, and that's why I finally decided to seek help.

Have you ever experienced any periods of abnormally elevated or irritable mood, or had any unusual thoughts, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others can't, during this time or at any other point in your life?

No, I have never had times where I felt abnormally high, hyperactive, or irritable; it has only been this deep low. However, I have heard voices and seen things that others can't, and had some really strange thoughts, but that only happens when my depression is at its worst. These scary experiences only started during this past year while I've been feeling so depressed.

Can you tell me more about when these voices, visions, and strange thoughts occur in relation to your depressive episodes - do they only happen when you're feeling depressed, or have there been times when you've experienced them without being in a depressive episode?

They only happen when I am feeling deeply depressed and at my absolute lowest. I have never experienced those voices or visions during times when my mood was normal or okay. They always seem to come hand-in-hand with this heavy darkness.

For how long have you experienced these depressive episodes with psychotic features, and have you had any periods where the psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices or seeing things, occurred for more than two weeks without a major depressive episode?

I've been dealing with all of this for about a year now. No, I have never experienced the voices or visions on their own or without the depression, not even for a few days, let alone two weeks. They only ever happen when I am feeling severely depressed.

Have you ever had a period of at least two months where you had delusions or hallucinations without a major depressive episode, which would suggest that the psychotic symptoms can occur independently of your depression?

No, absolutely not. Those experiences have never happened on their own, and certainly not for two months. They only ever occur when I am in the middle of this severe depression, and never when my mood is normal.
